notes: Sakura 0.2.4 fixes stale reservations left by interrupted Minecraft sessions, which could block launching or installing versions. The launcher now reconciles interrupted sessions at startup and exposes recovery in Settings > Diagnostics. If the old launcher cannot apply the update, use the platform repair package; do not delete your player data, profiles or worlds. Some old records may require a system restart. Includes Microsoft sign-in callback and installer fixes. Sakura's Minecraft Services access remains pending; this release does not claim that approval. This patch frees stale session reservations but does not repair already damaged world files.
